title: Bad design
text:
Bad design. The hole where you suck the air out should be in the middle of the bag, not at one end. The demos always show the final result as a flat package but in reality, you end up with a wrinkled mess which makes it impossible to even identify what you put in it. And you can't label it to tell you what you put in it, because it's so wrinkled, there's no place to put a label.

Also that "zipper" closer is a joke. There's no way to close it securely before you begin suction unless you only fill it half full.
